qa: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: When this card would be played, if there are 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, reduce the cost by 5. [On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 other Digimon as the top security card, trash both players' top security cards. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, you may play 1 play cost 8 or lower [Angel], [Archangel] or [Iliad] trait card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
